component.name: xl-Calculator
component.summary: A calculator for Linux Mint and the Cinnamon desktop

description.p: xl-Calculator is a calculator in the style of the Linux Mint X-Apps, with a classic menubar, the system theme and a history you can click to reuse earlier answers.

ul.li: Scientific: powers, roots, trigonometry, logarithms, and more
Financial: loans, savings, cash flows, and depreciation
Programmer: hexadecimal, decimal, octal, and binary, with bitwise operators
Unit Converter: twelve categories, converted as you type
Currency Converter: about 30 currencies, with exchange rates from the European Central Bank

description.p: It works to up to 50 decimal places, and can print its history like an adding-machine tape.
Xcalculator is now called xl-Calculator, alongside xl-Screenshot and xl-Annotate. Settings, history and downloaded rates are copied over the first time it starts. The title bar shows just the mode.
A calmer keypad: the number keys stand out, Clear is no longer red, backspace is also in the display, and Basic has a square root key. The icon has a darker border.
Spanish, French, German, and Brazilian Portuguese translations, a new icon, and a bordered history that follows the system theme.
A new Currency Converter mode, with the European Central Bank's exchange rates and optional automatic refresh.
Opening xl-Calculator again opens another window, and the windows share their settings and history. Settings are now kept in ~/.config/xl-calculator. Every word on screen can now be translated.
